title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E5 — A Matter Of Life And Breath
Lamont and Fred, at Lamont's insistence, take advantage of the free tests offered by a Breathmobile. The results convince Fred that he has tuberculosis.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E6 — We Were Robbed
Fred covers his clumsiness by proclaiming 'we were robbed' and he turns into a boastful hero cited for bravery. But Lamont finds the shattered remains of his prized porcelain and glass collection and decides to teach his father a lesson.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E7 — A Pad For Lamont
Angered by his father's constant interruption of his dates, Lamont moves out to pursue the life of a swinging bachelor. But much to Lamont's disappointment, it's the newly unchaperoned Fred who is besieged by the ladies.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E17 — Louise's Award
Louise's donation to charity might win her a special award, if George's 'donation' to a politician doesn't ruin her chances.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E18 — The Other Woman
Tom Willis' latest business trip may be his last if Helen finds out who he is traveling with and what kind of 'business' they have in mind.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E19 — The Hold Out
George gets caught between his morals and his money when his efforts to increase his take on a business deal turn him into an unlikely neighborhood hero.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E20 — The Ones You Love
The first casualty from George and Louise's vicious verbal battle could be the interviewer interested in their 'perfect marriage.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E21 — Every Night Fever
An evening out at the disco turns into 'every night fever' when George stretches a good thing a bit too far. Louise's frustration grows when she realizes that she is to blame.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E22 — Three Faces Of Florence
Florence's efforts to make herself more 'interesting' backfire when her new suitor turns out to be a psychiatrist -- and 'interesting' Florence is one of the worst cases he's seen. George and Louise are worried over Florence's condition.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E23 — Louise's Convention
There's foul play afoot when George tries to duck out of celebrating his wedding anniversary with Louise and she tries to duck out of town to attend a convention.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E22 — Barbara McNair, Stiller & Meara, Roy Clark
Roy & Barbara are selling door-to-door; Stiller & Meara do a women's lib skit and join Flip for a boxing sketch.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E23 — Joe Namath, George Carlin
Carlin does his 'Occupation: Foole' bit, hair poem and a newscast spoof with Flip; Geraldine ogles Namath.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E24 — Lily Tomlin, Ed McMahon, Sammy Davis Jr
Tomlin does her Edith Ann character; Flip & Sammy try car rental biz; Geraldine is a temp phone operator with Tomlin’s Ernestine.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E25 — Ruth Buzzi, Jackie Vernon, Lee Marvin
Ruth Buzzi does her park bench bit and joins Lee Marvin & Flip for a King Henry VIII sketch; Jackie does his slideshow routine.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E6 — Bill Withers/Mae Jackson
Featured guest Bill Withers sings hit single, "Ain't No Sunshine" and other selections from his album, Just As I Am.  In another segment, young poetess Mae Jackson reads from her own works.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E7 — Miriam Makeba/Muhammad Ali
Former heavyweight boxing champion Muhammad Ali, South African born singer Miriam Makeba and a three-man vocal group called the Delfonics, share the spotlight with guest-host Nikki Giovanni, who opens the show with her "Kidnap Poem".
